svg.text: MPx Boil-Loop Mini v0.5 · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. Extrusion profile Ø95 × 1.5 wall with 24 radial fins 5 × 1.2; cut to 230 ±0.3, deburr, ends square to 0.1.
2. Fins machined off locally (spot-face Ø16, depth to tube OD) at the spout and thermometer holes.
3. Body coil P04 bonded to the bore with thermally conductive epoxy (≥ 1.5 W/m·K), 0.1–0.2 bond line.
4. Prototype: plain 6063 tube Ø95 × 1.5 with clamp-on fin strip is acceptable.
